about_the_game:
What is this DLC...?


This DLC is a fanmade animation based on the original game, Touhou Mystia's Izakaya.
It mainly focuses on filling in gaps or expanding on the game's story from different points of view.

Characters

Mystia Lorelei
The night sparrow who runs Mystia's Izakaya. Loves singing and cooking. A bit clumsy at times, but always tries her best. Uses her singing and cooking to make every guest feel right at home. Currently working hard to pay off her friend's debt as well as develop new cooking and singing techniques. Her top-tier expertise combined with her friendly personality that gets along well with anyone has earned her a modest amount of fame throughout Gensokyo. People usually call her by the nickname "shopkeep".



Kyouko Kasodani
A Buddhist yamabiko training at Myouren Temple. A minor youkai on the same wavelength as Mystia. Helps Mystia run her izakaya as her assistant in her free time. In charge of serving the guests. Also formed a band with Mystia with the goal of bringing the best rock music to everyone in Gensokyo.



Kosuzu Motoori
The sole daughter of the Motoori family which runs a book renter in the Human Village. She was born with the ability to read complicated ciphers, thus allowing her to come into contact with the other side of Gensokyo. Exceptionally curious towards youkai. Works at Mystia's Izakaya in order to observe youkai while helping out.
Her wit and eloquence makes her naturally suited for the straight-man role.





As profits rise in Mystia's Izakaya, so has the number of helpers.
Today is one of those rare days where Kosuzu is free, but no one expected her to ask the one devastating question that should never be asked:
"So, who among us in Mystia's Izakaya is the strongest, really?"

This one innocent question swept through Kyouko like a harrowing tornado.
In a place mainly consisting of the strong and youkai who worship strength, this is the number one taboo you never bring up!

Thus, the penultimate question of who among the partners truly is the strongest.
The heroic debate of Mystia's Izakaya, now presented in animation form!
